Path: the customer's own language | 缺项 (form chrome defaults beyond `WizardForm`'s footer are English literals) | P2

## Triage: first grade — `bug` · `i18n` · `priority:p2` · `domain:ui` · `area:records` · `pm:queue`. Direction: the objectui#10999 pattern, across the family, in one PR

Triage: lands in `packages/plugin-form/src/` (`ObjectForm`, `WizardForm`, `MasterDetailForm`, `TabbedForm`, `SplitForm`, `DrawerForm`, `ModalForm`) and `apps/console/src/components/FormPage.tsx` ⇒ `domain:ui`.

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-09-29T04:59Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

**Why p2.** It is objectui#10999's class (p2) on the rest of the form family. Every non-English customer sees 「Created」, 「Saved」, 「Thanks!」, 「Loading form...」 and 「Error loading form」.

**Direction: as the card says.**
- Route each default through the package's `createSafeTranslation` hook, with pack keys in all ten locales. An authored value still wins, as objectui#10999's pin requires.
- Read `NAVIGATE_ON_SUCCESS_REFUSED_NOTE` before including it. It joins only if it is shown to an end user.
- **Pins:** a zh-CN render of each default and an authored-override control. The English-literal fixtures move with the change: those are pin updates, not regressions.
- **Not serial.** PR objectui#11038 (objectui#10999) merged at 2026-09-29T03:46Z.

- A changeset.

⛔ An authored value still wins, as objectui#10999's pin requires. No schema key is added, renamed or retyped.
Stop on breach; explain in the report.
Container & model: `M`, `mode:subagent`, `model: opus` (TIER_DEFAULT, objectstack `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs:12692` at `81137630`)
Clause-②: no
Why no: rendered default text moves into the packs; no published type, schema key, spec row or documented contract moves.

Dispatch note: under the maintainer's 「当前没有fable，你可以派 opus 卡」 (this seat's chat, 2026-09-29T01:00Z), this card needs no review at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`. The seat verifies the wording and the changeset prose itself at the ACCEPT.
Serial constraints cleared: read 2026-09-29T07:28Z at objectui `origin/main`. PR objectui#11050 (seat 2, objectui#10993 batch 1: `object-form` resolves its seven `I18nLabel` members, editing `ObjectForm.tsx`) merged 2026-09-29T07:15Z. This card builds on it. No open PR touches `packages/plugin-form/src`.

## ACCEPT — PR objectui#11066 (`Fixes #11039`) · `domain:ui` seat #1 · 2026-09-29T08:54Z

`session_01DuWo5bdP9SdVebamn99GGk` (`os-steve`), the claiming seat (claim `5885696581`). Checked against GitHub, objectui `origin/main` and the PR head, ⛔ not against the report.

**Checklist**
- **Shape.** Draft → `main`. The body opens `Fixes #11039`, then `Clause-②: no` at line start. ⚠️ The PR has no assignee: the dev's `label-write --assign os-steve` was refused by the auto-mode classifier ("External System Writes"). Per the permission rule, the seat does not re-run a write a subagent was refused, and it was reported to the maintainer.
- **Scope.** 33 files, +962 / −134. The form family's default chrome goes through the packs: `createSafeTranslation` in `plugin-form`, including a new shared `formChrome.ts`, and `useObjectTranslation` in the console's `FormPage`. It covers:
  - the success toast (`form.created` / `form.saved` / `form.savedNamed`), and the refused-`navigateOnSuccess` note that rides it as its description;
  - the thank-you heading;
  - the loading line and the load-failure heading;
  - the default Create / Update / Save / Cancel labels in the seven containers.

  It builds on PR objectui#11050's `I18nLabel` resolution: authored values still win behind the same fallbacks, and no schema key moves.
- **Keys.** Six are new under `form.` in all ten packs. It reuses `form.create` / `form.update`, `common.save` / `common.cancel` / `common.loading`, and three `publicForm` keys. The seat confirmed on `origin/main` that no non-locale source reads `publicForm.loading`, `.thankYouTitle` or `.thankYouMessage`.
- **Also corrected in prose, declared:** the pending objectui#10935 changeset said the defaults "are still English". That line would publish false beside this entry, so it is reworded with its frontmatter untouched.
- **Governed-surface predicate.** 33 paths: `NOT governed`.
- **Checks on head `80db9c47a`.** 43 check-runs: 40 success, 3 skipped, 0 failure, `Spec Main Shape Gate` and `Bundle Analysis` included. Eager closure +322 gzip bytes; the budget is 3107.2 of 3149.4 KB.
- **Commits.** Three, trailers model-free.
- **Pins.** 29 cases across the containers plus 5 on `FormPage`: zh per container, authored-override controls, and en. The base blobs red 43 of the pins and moved fixtures, with the controls green. Restore proven by blob.

**Wording and prose, verified by the seat** (no review at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` is owed: `Clause-②: no`, dispatched under the maintainer's 「当前没有fable，你可以派 opus 卡」):
- zh reads naturally: 已创建, 已保存, 已提交, 表单加载失败, and 感谢您的提交！ (full-width mark).
- The changeset matches the diff.
- Its three declared English changes are true: `Loading form…` with U+2026; `Thanks!` → `Thank you!`, the value `publicForm.thankYouTitle` already carries on `main`; and the form page's message gaining "successfully".

**The dev's open question (thank-you wording): the seat takes A.** It keeps the reuse of the dead `publicForm` thank-you keys, with the English change declared. The brief asked for reuse where a key already means the same thing, and this converges the console form page on `EmbeddableForm`'s documented `publicForm` vocabulary.

**Carried to a new card, objectui#11071** (filed in this act): the remainder of the same family.
- Measured: the form page's `Submit`, `Submitting…`, `Uploading…`, `Redirecting…` and `Required: …`. `publicForm.submit` / `.submitting` already exist.
- Source-read only: `MasterDetailForm`'s line-item chrome and two other form strings.

**Landing**: not governed, green, `Clause-②: no` ⇒ `pr_ready` then `automerge_enable` through the relay, after this record reads back. At the merge the card closes by `Fixes`; the seat verifies by content and strips `pm:dispatched` and the assignee.
